design: design-tile DESIGN.md corrected by design-tile-review REVIEW.md (the review wins) and the owner's decisions of 2026-10-14: D1 prefill now on the reachable wgmma tiles 64x128x64 w8 and 128x128x64 w8 (decode tiles later); D2 NATIVE certifies, SHARED secondary; D3 rental A's selection rules make rental B mechanical; D4 'each shape' is each model; D5 MVA2 is SEEN-fitted for mma.sync; D6 a failed tA-e1cal STOPS rental B; D7 deepseek-v2-lite is SEEN-SHAPE ('new model, seen shapes'); D8 Granite is cut; D9 term (b) not revised first; D10 about $11.4
what: the dead-CTA lever at occupancy 2 (design-tile 3.1 step 7, design-tile-review 7): SHARED at 15 against 9 copies on OLMoE 128x128x64 w8 G 1, where the hidden window kappa x occ x S' x c is half R3's

pages.tread: n 1, uniform and balanced (design-tile-review 7 and 9.12: the increment does not depend on n)

statistic: per (label): delta = [(T_S - T_N) at c15 - (T_S - T_N) at c9] - [(A_S - A_N) at c15 - (A_S - A_N) at c9], the second bracket the align growth read off each page's own align_probe (design-tile-review 9.12); delta is the median over the page's (label) cells
se: se(delta) = 2 x sigma_page x mean(T) / sqrt(cells): four timed cells per difference; sigma_page is tA-rep's when it ran, else rental 3's 0.18% (design-tile-review 9.8)

rule.D against SLOT: each law's z = (delta - law) / se; EXCLUDED when |z| > 3. D (0.995 ns, kappa 0.325) and SLOT (4.05 ns / occ) differ by 12 to 17 us here (at R3's occupancy they did not separate)
rule.kappa 0.325 against smaller kappa: scored only when the measured c_128 >= 900 cycles (below it every kappa hides nothing and the laws coincide); the comparison is D against 'kappa 0.15' and 'kappa 0'
NOT SEPARABLE (stated before the page): D2 against D (v2): within 0.3 us at every c_128
kappa 0 against kappa 0.15: identical at every c_128 here
rule.consequence: none for E1-TILE (NATIVE): the reading informs term (b)'s copies question (D9) and E1-TILE-S

labels.pages: BLIND-CALMODEL (OLMoE is CAL-counters for d and kappa: the laws' constants are SEEN-fitted)

scorer_ambiguities.1 which c is the denominator, and F's un: c_time = c_card x c_counter(tile) / 344.1 (344.1 the CAL counters' c); F is held in counter cycles and PHI = F / c_counter(tile) in k-steps; at R3's tile v4 is v3 exactly (r3_timing_model_v4.py --check)
